case_title: Mani v. State of Kerala and Others
statutory_provisions: IPC s. 300, Exception 4, s. 304 (Part I); s. 34 IPC
trial_court_outcome: Convicted accused Nos. 1 to 4 u/ss. 302, 341 and 324 r/w s. 34 IPC
high_court_outcome: Upheld conviction of accused No. 1 u/s. 302, and conviction of accused Nos. 2 to 4 u/ss. 324 and 341 r/w s. 34
neutral_facts: The incident occurred when eight individuals, who were celebrating their party's victory in panchayat elections, decided to go towards Chozhiyamkod. The accused, riding on two motorcycles, suddenly confronted the group. The accused had no prior knowledge that the victims were moving towards Chozhiyamkod. A fight ensued, resulting in injuries to the victims. The deceased, Soman, was stabbed on the chest by the accused, leading to his death. The injuries inflicted on the accused were not serious, and the accused had no prior enmity with the victims. The prosecution's case relied on the testimony of injured witnesses, but the statements were inconsistent. The accused consistently claimed that the deceased was killed by the appellant.
